```
['run the script to find ions and glycans in the CCD pickle and write results to a path', 'run find_ions_and_glycans_in_ccd on a CCD mapping to extract glycans and ions as frozensets', 'review find_ions_and_glycans_in_ccd to understand how it classifies saccharides and ions from CCD data', 'refactor find_ions_and_glycans_in_ccd to support additional chemical component categories beyond glycans and ions', 'summarize the main function that loads CCD pickle, finds ions and glycans, and writes results']
```
